class.name: astar_planner/AstarAvoidHolesOctoPlanner
class.description: A* planner that avoids holes using an OctoMap.

class.name: astar_planner/AvoidHolesExplorationPlanner
class.description: Exploration planner: reforms the avoid-holes graph, picks the walkable node with the most unknown space around it (the frontier), pulls it back to the nearest low-penalty node via BFS, and plans A* to it. The incoming goal is ignored.
